purpose: Teach: 従軍/感受性/故人/発砲/怠っ/氾濫/乱用/断絶

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、従軍経験者の証言、本当に、丁寧に、扱われていましたね、感動的な、研究でした、本当に、印象的な、内容、桜さん、評価できます、本当に、立派でした、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — the way you handled the testimony from wartime veterans in your paper was so careful. It was genuinely moving research, really striking work.
lines.style: Warm and measured. Slight pause before naming him. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone acknowledging real work thoughtfully, not performing praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時下の人々の、感受性、本当に、繊細な視点で、論じました、論文で、貴重な、研究、できました、本気で、絶対、深い、研究、できました、本当に、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to discuss the sensitivity of people living under wartime conditions with that careful lens. I was able to do valuable research — genuinely deep research — and I'm truly grateful for the opportunity.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Slight tension in the shoulders at the start, then settling. Speaking carefully, choosing words. Respectful to the audience — the war and the witnesses — not just the teacher.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 故人となった証言者の方々、本当に、貴重な、証言、残してくださいましたね、論文の中で、丁寧に、扱われていました、本当に、感動的な、扱いでしたね、桜さん、絶対、立派です。
lines.en: The witnesses who have passed — they left us such precious testimony. The way you handled it in your paper was so gentle, so moving. That really was outstanding work.
lines.style: Softer pace. A brief pause before 'witnesses' — acknowledging their absence. Reflective but warm. Not lecturing; sharing weight. Voice settles low at the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時、街中で、発砲事件、起きていた地域も、複数、ありました、論文で、論じました、本当に、悲しい、歴史でした、絶対、繰り返さないように、訴えました、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. There were multiple regions where street violence broke out during that period, and I wrote about them in the paper. It was such sad history — the kind we absolutely have to make sure never happens again. I really wanted to make that clear.
lines.style: Voice firms slightly on 'multiple regions'. Slower pace when discussing the violence. Not detached; genuinely affected. The last clause ('make sure never happens again') carries weight — conviction beneath the formal register.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 安全管理を、怠っていた、政府、戦中の、責任、論文で、しっかり、論じていますね、桜さん、本当に、視点、独自で、視野、広いですね、本当に、感心しました、本気で、立派。
lines.en: The government's neglect of safety measures during the war, their responsibility — you wrote about it so thoroughly in the paper. Your perspective is really your own, your scope is wide. I was genuinely impressed by that.
lines.style: Engaged but not effusive. Clear emphasis on 'thoroughly' — marking the rigor. Slight lift in tone when naming his independent thinking. Sincere without sentimentality. Closing warmly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。情報の氾濫、戦時下、人々を、混乱させた、と、論文で、論じました、現代の、SNS時代にも、繋がる、テーマでした、本当に、深い、研究、できました、本気で、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. I explored how the flood of information during wartime confused people and clouded their judgment. It's a theme that connects to our modern age of social media — the same patterns repeating. I was able to do genuinely deep work on it, and I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting the threads aloud. Gentle acceleration when linking past to present. The gratitude at the end is sincere and grounded, not performative. Breath settles at the close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の権力乱用、論文で、本当に、丁寧に、論じていますね、現代にも、警鐘を、鳴らす、重要な視点、含めて、書きました、本当に、立派な、研究、桜さん、絶対、評価できます、本気。
lines.en: The abuse of power during wartime — you examined it so carefully in your paper. And you included that crucial perspective, that warning for us now in this time. That was really outstanding research.
lines.style: Deliberate pacing. A small emphasis on 'warning for us now' — making the bridge between history and present moment. Warm but serious. The final phrase is genuine assessment, not platitude. Slight settling inward on the last word.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。家族の断絶、戦争の悲劇として、論文で、扱いました、本当に、辛い、歴史でした、絶対、平和を、守る大切さ、訴えました、本気で、最後の章で、感動的に、書きました、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Yes. I wrote about family separation as one of war's deepest tragedies. It was such painful history to reckon with. But I wanted to make absolutely clear the importance of protecting peace — and in the final chapter, I tried to write about that with the weight it deserves.
lines.style: Voice quiets on 'family separation'. Slower, more deliberate as approaching the gravity of the subject. The final sentence builds slightly — conviction and emotion beneath formal register. Closes with quiet sincerity, not exhaustion.
